# Scooter Insurance

## About
Scooter Insurance (scooterinsurance.co) is a specialty insurance agency for scooter & moped rental shops, moped dealers, and shared e-scooter fleet operators. We place coverage through specialty carriers that knowingly write rental, dealer, and shared-mobility risk — coverage standard carriers exclude. A division of Contractors Choice Agency, NPN #8608479, licensed in all 50 states since 2005.

## Why Scooter Businesses Need Specialty Coverage
Putting riders on scooters and mopeds — or running a dealership and service shop — creates real public and fleet exposure. Standard business policies exclude scooter/moped rental, powersports, and shared mobility. Rental agreements and damage deposits help but are not insurance and won't cover a totaled or stolen unit or a serious injury claim. Agreements and insurance work together.

## Services
- General Liability Insurance: Third-party bodily injury and property damage from your operations; satisfies landlord and city-permit requirements.
- Rental Fleet Physical Damage: Protects your scooters and mopeds against collision, tip-overs, theft, and vandalism — including while a renter has them.
- Participant Accident Insurance: No-fault medical benefits for renters and riders injured using your units, reducing lawsuits.
- Garage & Dealers Coverage: Garagekeepers protection for customer units in a dealer's care, plus open-lot inventory and garage liability.
- Commercial Property Insurance: Shop/showroom, charging equipment and batteries, tools, and inventory; equipment breakdown and business interruption.
- Commercial Auto Insurance: Vans and trucks used to transport, deploy, and rebalance the fleet.
- Workers Compensation Insurance: Medical and wage-replacement benefits for injured mechanics, rental staff, and fleet crews.

## Target Audience
Scooter and moped rental shops, moped and scooter dealers, shared e-scooter fleet operators, micromobility startups, and powersports retailers with rental fleets.
